project_summary: Wellness mobile app synchronised with wearables

components.name: Flutter mobile app
components.description: Cross-platform app with activity rings, sleep and heart rate charts, goals, streaks and offline mode.

components.name: Wearables synchronisation
components.description: Background synchronisation with Apple HealthKit and Google Fit, conflict resolution between sources and battery-friendly scheduling.

components.name: Backend API
components.description: REST API for user profiles, goals and aggregated health metrics, with token authentication and GDPR data export.
